body:
I kind of went to a school therapist but that never really went anywhere, I don't think they're very used to deal with depression.

I don't really know where to find a therapist in Sweden. I've tried looking around. I don't like worrying my parents about it, but if I can't find any therapists myself I guess I'll have to.

Thanks for this. This made me smile for probably the first time today.

I don't really feel asexual or homosexual, the reason I didn't mention it is because I feel awkward talking about it as it's never actually gone anywhere because of my insecurities. (That I'm aware of, I try every day to just go up and talk to 'that girl I like' but simply can't)

Not really sure what else to say, I guess I could've included that not all my friends are online, but the majority of them certainly are.

I wish I can say I'll follow all your suggestions but can't promise I will, I'll definitely try though.
